newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan tax increase to hurt consumer sentiment - EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan tax increase to hurt consumer sentiment - EPA.

text.p: Japanese consumer sentiment is likely to worsen in the next six months because of the consumption tax increase on April 1, the Economic Planning Agency's (EPA) quarterly survey showed on Thursday.

The index, which measures consumer attitudes toward purchases in the next six months, fell 5.5 percentage points to 35.6 in the latest survey. The figure is the lowest since the agency initiated the survey in June 1982.
It was also the third consecutive quarter in which sentiment worsened. The survey covered 5,031 households.
"The impact of the consumption tax increase was bigger than expected," an EPA official told reporters.
